remaining_limits: Necessary-label superset can contain labels with no complete feasible extension.
Activity-energy reduction need not reduce full-window energy with auto-L and temperature leakage.
Current rule deliberately does not cover every possible useful release.
The extra 112 labels do not bound actual model rows, root LP time or budgeted solution quality.
R1 and R3 are development examples, not unseen validation.
Production lifecycle and deadline tests remain required before any future execution.
